title: CEP-0008 Semantic Envelope (canonical full profile)
description: Canonical full JSON Schema profile of CEP-0008's Semantic Envelope. Every CEP-0008 §52 minimal-valid field is an explicit top-level property, plus §7.1 lineage_refs. The envelope_kind vocabulary is CEP-0008 §9's closed list. Entity sections follow the SHOULD vocabularies of CEP-0008 §13–§39; extension material belongs in the §39 extensions section. The separately named flat profile (semantic-envelope.schema.json) is a limited compatibility profile and is not this contract. Field names come only from CEP-0008; see semantic-envelope.mapping.md for the §53 fixture map.

anyOf.description: envelope must carry validation_status and at least one CEP entity section
envelope must carry conformance_status and at least one CEP entity section

envelope_id.description: CEP-0008 §7.1. Unique identity of this emission; varies per emission.

cep_version.description: CEP-0008 §7.1/§12. Version of the CEP specification this envelope conforms to.

envelope_version.description: CEP-0008 §7.1/§12. Version of the envelope structure.

envelope_kind.description: CEP-0008 §9. Closed vocabulary; new kinds must be defined by CEP-0008.

created_at.description: CEP-0008 §7.1. RFC 3339 UTC timestamp; metadata only, never an ordering authority.

created_by.description: CEP-0008 §7.1. The actual producer of the envelope.

scope.description: CEP-0008 §7.1/§52. Evaluation context. Context-defined; common fields are documented as optional properties.

boundary_record.description: CEP-0008 §8.1/§52. What is included, excluded, omitted, unknown, and limited.

completeness_status.description: CEP-0008 §10/§52. SHOULD be one of: complete_for_context, partial, minimal, unknown, invalid, out_of_scope. Context-specific values are lawful.

omission_status.description: CEP-0008 §34/§52. Known omissions MUST be marked, never silently absent.

provenance_refs.description: CEP-0008 §12/§52/§15. References to provenance records; an envelope without provenance is not settlement-valid.

validation_status.description: CEP-0008 §52. Envelope validation result; subject/model validation is a distinct record field.

conformance_status.description: CEP-0008 §38/§52. Conformance result of the envelope against CEP requirements.

lineage_refs.description: CEP-0008 §7.1. Prior envelope ids for the same subject.

content_hash.description: CEP-0008 §7.2. Stable hash of the represented content.

semantic_hash.description: CEP-0008 §7.2. Stable semantic identity of the represented content.

signature_refs.description: CEP-0008 §7.2. A signature is never verification of truth.

representations.description: CEP-0008 §22 Representations Section. Carries bounded representations; content is inline via inline_content or by reference via content_ref (CEP-0008 §14.2).

omission_record.description: CEP-0008 §34. Known omissions MUST be marked.

uncertainty_record.description: CEP-0008 §35. Unknown stays distinct from false, absent, not applicable, redacted, and out of scope.

validation_status.description: Validation status of the represented content, distinct from envelope validation_status.

states.description: CEP-0008 §23 States Section. Declared State and Observed State MUST remain separable.

transformations.description: CEP-0008 §24 Transformations Section. Action MUST remain distinct from Transformation.

observations.description: CEP-0008 §25 Observations Section. Observation MUST remain distinct from occurrence and evidence.

questions.description: CEP-0008 §26 Questions Section. Question semantics from CEP-0005 MUST be preserved.

claims.description: CEP-0008 §27 Claims Section. Claims MUST remain distinct from evidence.

evidence.description: CEP-0008 §28 Evidence Section. Evidence semantics from CEP-0006 MUST be preserved. Data MUST remain distinct from Evidence.

settlements.description: CEP-0008 §29 Settlements Section. Settlement semantics from CEP-0007 MUST be preserved. Completion MUST remain distinct from Settlement.

authority.description: CEP-0008 §30 Authority Section. Authority MUST remain distinct from capability; possibility MUST remain distinct from permissibility.

affordances.description: CEP-0008 §31 Affordances Section. Affordance MUST remain distinct from possibility.

benchmarks.description: CEP-0008 §33.2 Benchmark Records. A Benchmark without a primary Question is not CEP-valid.

omissions.description: CEP-0008 §34 Omissions Section. Absence MUST NOT be interpreted as falsehood unless explicitly justified.

uncertainty.description: CEP-0008 §35 Uncertainty Section. Unknown MUST remain distinct from false, absent, not applicable, redacted, and out of scope.

contradictions.description: CEP-0008 §36 Contradictions Section. Known contradictions MUST NOT be hidden.

debt.description: CEP-0008 §37 Debt Section. Settlement with debt MUST NOT be treated as clean full settlement.

extensions.description: CEP-0008 §39. Extensions allow domain-specific information without corrupting the CEP core and MUST NOT overwrite core CEP semantics.
